summary: On July 27, 2026, argenx SE (Nasdaq/Euronext: ARGX) announced a definitive agreement to acquire Forte Biosciences, Inc. (Nasdaq: FBRX) for $77 per share in cash, implying a total equity value of about $2.2 billion—building on argenx's prior strategic investment in Forte. The target's lead asset, FB102, is a first-in-class anti-CD122 antibody with Phase 1b proof-of-concept in vitiligo and celiac disease. The transaction reflects argenx's disciplined M&A approach, adding pipeline-in-a-product potential across autoimmune diseases. A conference call was held the same day. Watch for shareholder approval, antitrust review, and deal completion timeline; risk-arb centers on regulatory and closing conditions.
